citation.authors: Victoire A, Magin P et al

record.population: 310 children aged 0 to 24 months, six trials
record.design: Cochrane review of treatments for infantile seborrhoeic dermatitis (cradle cap)
record.finding: Six trials compared oral biotin against placebo, proprietary products against placebo or control shampoo, and topical steroids against other products; the trials were short (10 to 42 days) and the results were based on very low-quality evidence.
record.note: Trials not in Black children specifically.
